title: TK Escape
specs: Escape rooms require brain power, not physical strength
Themes include magic school, military espionage, pirate treasure, and escape from poisonous gas
One participating adult required for players under 18
Rooms accommodate 2 to 8 players depending on game
Booking less than full room may place you with strangers
Booking full room guarantees private group
gap: Price per person or per room not stated
blurb: Guests participate in themed escape rooms where they solve puzzles and discover clues to escape within a time limit. Rooms accommodate 2 to 8 players and last about 60 minutes. The experience requires mental effort, not physical strength, and is suitable for ages 10 and up with an adult for minors.
extraNote: Arrive 15 minutes prior to game · Online booking closes 4 hours prior to game time · Tickets are non-refundable · Reschedule with 24 hours notice for emergencies · No food or drinks allowed in the escape room · No electronic devices allowed in the room · TK Escape location in downtown Mobile
